brief:
Israel forced a Palestinian Israeli political leader to withdraw from candidacy while permitting far-right Israeli candidates to compete in elections, according to Al Jazeera English. The move highlights a disparity in how electoral authorities have treated candidates from different political camps ahead of the polls.

The decision to exclude the Arab leader stands in contrast to the clearance given to far-right figures, raising questions about consistency in the application of electoral rules.
dek: Palestinian Israeli leader forced to withdraw candidature while far-right Israeli leaders allowed to run in polls.
title: Israel bars Arab leader, allows far-right candidates to run
